decisions.statement: The file written is the one every shell the harness starts sources.
A name written reaches the next call without anything being restarted.
A name the file already holds is replaced where that name sits.
A name the file holds without `export` is replaced by one with it.
A name no line holds is appended at the end.
A name another name opens with is not mistaken for that name.
The file is left readable by its owner alone.
A value carrying a quote the shell would act on is refused.
No value written here is answered back to the caller.

definition: a secret written into the workstation env file the shell reads
